lines.2: --Or so it was supposed to be!
lines.4: 「It is already nine. How long do you intend to sleep?」
lines.6: 「You should have slept for approximately eight hours.」
lines.7: 「Yeah, but it's my day off. I thought I'd indulge in sleeping late.」
lines.8: 「Has fatigue accumulated? Shall I massage you?」
lines.9: 「It's nothing like that. I just kind of want to sleep on my days off.」
lines.10: 「I cannot let you remain in bed for such a reason.」
lines.11: 「Now get up. Life is full of things to do.」
lines.12: 「Oh, come on. How are you this energetic?」
lines.13: 「Your language is rather coarse when you first wake up.」
lines.14: 「Wash your face and clear your head.」
lines.15: 「Unless you are truly suffering? If so, say so.」
lines.17: 「Have you always walked down the stairs while staggering like that...? It is dangerous.」
lines.18: She smoothly reached out to support me.
lines.19: She was a nag, but she was a good person.
lines.20: After washing my face, I finally grasped the situation.
lines.22: 「I finished the laundry some time ago.」
lines.23: 「Fortunately, your washing machine is the same model as ours. I learned to use it through grueling, blood-soaked training.」
lines.25: S-She'd even hung up my underwear...
lines.26: 「Otome, it's fine. I can do my own laundry.」
lines.27: 「But I prefer to wash my own clothing.」
lines.28: 「I am merely washing yours while I am at it. What is your objection?」
lines.29: 「I don't really mind, but are you okay handling men's boxers?」
lines.30: 「Yes. I have always washed my family's clothing.」
lines.31: 「I cannot shriek over every little thing like that. How absurd.」
